## Scope

- [ ] This fits Rift's design (small, fast, content-addressed, pack-file).
- [ ] I checked `docs/DESIGN.md` and `CHANGELOG.md` and this isn't already
      shipped or explicitly out of scope.
- [ ] I'm not asking for a full git clone. Rift is a separate VCS; interop
      with git is via `rift push` / `rift pull` / `rift clone <git-url>`.
